prompt:
Subject:
Gaze Dissolving into White

Main Subject:
A vertical full-body fashion portrait of a female model sitting on a square platform of the same color in a pale pink studio. Positioned slightly right of center, capturing from the top of the head to the tips of black pumps. The person occupies about 75% of the frame, with wide negative space on the top left and left side.

Person/Expression:
A woman in her 20s. Light ivory-beige skin with natural pink complexion and delicate texture. Champagne beige and pink-brown eye makeup, long thin lashes, soft brown eyebrows, and glossy pink-beige lips. Chin slightly tucked, looking at the front camera with a calm expression.

Clothing/Pose:
A white satin mini-dress with thin straps. Elegant V-neckline with delicate white lace trim. Black pointed-toe high heels. Sitting on the right side of the platform, right leg extended long forward, left leg bent high and crossed over the right. Right hand on the thigh, left elbow bent with fingertips lightly touching under the chin.

Background/Light:
A minimalist photo studio with uniform dusty pink background and floor. A large circular spotlight is positioned behind the person, gradient from pale ivory center to pink edges. Primary light is a slightly hard warm light from the upper left.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 3:4, full-body long shot. Camera at a height slightly lower than the waist, near eye-level with slight telephoto compression. Focus on the face and upper body while clearly depicting down to the toes.

Texture/Style:
A realistic studio photograph combining Japanese beauty magazines and fashion catalogs. Carefully depicts the soft luster of satin, fine lace patterns, natural pores, and individual hair strands. Milk tea ash brown hair with thin see-through bangs.

Negative:
Minors, unnatural face, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, unnatural leg crossing, deformed shoes, floating, incorrect perspective, shadows inconsistent with light sources, plastic-like skin, excessive skin correction, text, logos, watermarks.

promptZh:
主体：
凝视消融于纯白

核心主体：
一张竖构图的全身时尚人像，模特坐在浅粉色影棚内同色系的方形平台上。模特位于画面中心偏右位置，取景范围从头顶至黑色高跟鞋尖。人物占据约 75% 的画面，左上方及左侧留有大面积负空间。

人物/表情：
20 多岁的女性。浅象牙米色皮肤，透着自然的粉色气色，肤质细腻。香槟米色与粉棕色眼妆，长而纤细的睫毛，柔和的棕色眉毛，以及光泽感的粉米色嘴唇。下巴微收，神情平静地注视着正前方的镜头。

服装/姿态：
一件白色缎面吊带迷你裙。优雅的 V 领设计，配有精致的白色蕾丝边。黑色尖头高跟鞋。 坐在平台右侧，右腿向前伸展，左腿高高弯曲并叠放在右腿上。右手放在大腿上，左手肘弯曲，指尖轻触下巴下方。

背景/光影：
极简摄影棚，背景和地面均为统一的灰粉色。人物后方设有一个大型圆形聚光灯，光线从中心浅象牙色向边缘粉色渐变。 主光源为来自左上方的微硬暖光。

构图/相机：
竖构图 3:4，全身远景。相机高度略低于腰部，接近视平线，带有轻微的长焦压缩感。对焦于面部及上半身，同时清晰呈现至脚尖。

质感/风格：
写实风格的影棚摄影，融合了日本美容杂志与时尚目录的风格。细腻刻画缎面的柔和光泽、精细的蕾丝纹理、自然的毛孔以及每一根发丝。奶茶灰棕色发色，配有轻薄的空气刘海。

负面提示词：
未成年人、不自然的脸部、多余的手指、缺失的手指、肢体融合、关节断裂、不自然的交叉腿、变形的鞋子、悬浮、透视错误、与光源不一致的阴影、塑料质感皮肤、过度磨皮、文字、Logo、水印。
